title.narrative: Strengthening community participation in policy and decision-making processes in Swaziland

description.narrative:
This project aims to contribute towards the development of a democratic society that reflects the will of the people of Swaziland.
Swaziland is beset by a series of ongoing socio-economic challenges manifesting themselves in, amongst other things, deteriorating healthcare, social welfare services, high rates of HIV and AIDS, gender-based violence, poverty, as well as a below-average rate of economic growth being worsened by fiscal instability. Within this context, the weaknesses in the country’s system of governance has become more exposed, and the calls for political transformation of the current Tinkhundla system of governance into a pluralistic and democratic constitutional dispensation from both inside and outside Swaziland have become more pronounced.
The historically deliberate de-politicisation of the Swazi populace and the sanction that has been meted against those who express dissent with the authorities have meant that the governing authorities from the community to the national level have been able to create and sustain fear amongst Swazis. This has resulted in the populace’s acceptance of and resignation to violations thus denying them their right to participate in governance and to hold authorities accountable for their actions.
In this new initiative, an innovative empowerment approach will be incorporated into civic education campaigns in communities. The results of civic education work in these communities will inform the development of a grassroots campaign for changes at a local level.
